title: Q-OWNER-IDENTITY-1: owner sign-in anchored on GitHub identity, emails as linked identifiers with an audit log
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::/api/owner/github
**Status:** open

OWNER-IDENTITY-1 (Rowan 2026-11-17). Identity, not email, is the root of trust. The owner is whoever controls the GitHub owner account of the ultrastable org. Owner sign-in: GitHub OAuth, then the callback checks the GitHub login against the org owner list in the repo (doctrine data) and mints the session; passkeys are bound after that sign-in. Email addresses (any provider: Gmail, Outlook, others) are verified contact identifiers LINKED to that one identity; a link is made only from an authenticated owner session or by proving control of the address (code received), and every link, unlink and sign-in is appended to an audit table (identifier_links, owner_audit) with time, method and masked address. An email is never the root of trust and the owner never has to change an address held at another service (the Cloudflare account email may differ from the owner contact address). Email codes stay as a fallback channel only (MAIL-RELAY-1 fixes the sender-domain failure; probe mail_send). Safety standard: session needs a fresh GitHub OAuth or passkey step-up for changes; no sign-in by an unlinked address.

Build: GET /api/owner/github (start, state+PKCE), callback, org-owner check, audit tables in dashboard/schema.sql, tests in dashboard/test. Closing probe: grep:dashboard/worker.js::/api/owner/github and node --test dashboard/test.
